entries.en: The image showed bacterial plaque along the gumline.
entries.zh: 图像显示牙龈边缘有牙菌斑。

entries.en: The historian studied reports of bacteriological warfare.
entries.zh: 历史学家研究了有关细菌战的报告。

entries.en: The badminton racket lay beside a tube of shuttlecocks.
entries.zh: 羽毛球拍放在一筒羽毛球旁边。

entries.en: Her bait casting sent the heavy lure beyond the reeds.
entries.zh: 她投饵时把沉重的假饵抛到了芦苇丛外。

entries.en: The stall sold baked goods wrapped in paper bags.
entries.zh: 摊位出售用纸袋包装的焙烤食品。

entries.en: The baked potato still had its crisp skin.
entries.zh: 烤土豆仍带着酥脆的皮。

entries.en: Snow clung to his balaclava helmet after the walk.
entries.zh: 走过一段路后，他的巴拉克拉瓦盔式帽上沾着雪。
